en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Hassan Bin Salih Al Sowry, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Aliasws was saying: ‘The one weasws hit the legal penalty (Hadd) upon and he dies, so there is no wergild for him upon usasws, and the one weasws hit the legal penalty (Hadd) upon regarding something from the rights of the people, and he dies, so his wergild is upon usasws’.
